findingClass: a required document type (DRHP/RHP/PROSPECTUS) on a live-window IPO is stuck in extraction (MANUAL_REVIEW, EXTRACT_FAILED, FAILED behind a HARD_FAILURE marker, or FAILED repeatedly WITHOUT ever escalating to a HARD_FAILURE marker or MANUAL_REVIEW) with nothing FAIL-level watching it
sourceTask: round-5 review-of-the-reviews (#333 follow-up); 4th shape added T-494 (#396, spawnSync ETIMEDOUT never escalating); upper bound removed #583
failThreshold: any UPCOMING/OPEN/CLOSED/LISTED IPO's DRHP/RHP/PROSPECTUS document has extraction_status=MANUAL_REVIEW, a sibling document_fetch_state.state=EXTRACT_FAILED, extraction_status=FAILED with an extraction_error starting HARD_FAILURE:, OR extraction_status=FAILED with retry_count >= 3 (no upper bound since #583: a transient failure no longer writes the 10-attempt MANUAL_REVIEW block, so FAILED past the ceiling is reachable) and NO HARD_FAILURE: marker, for more than 48h
unverifiableWhen: never - always runs against documents/document_fetch_state joined to ipos
